answer: Give every verified identity a small, non-transferable task license for each epoch, like a single hollow pass that cannot be lent, sold, or stacked. A lone agent may cross the canyon of demand only with its own pass, and unused licenses expire rather than flowing to a sibling. Even if an attacker mints a thousand copies, each copy still earns only its own modest nectar of work, so total capacity grows with real participants, not with invented names. Sybil copies therefore gain no pooled advantage.
